prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Six new animation pose drawings of the exact cream bellflower in the reference, for Aseprite. PORTRAIT 1024 x 1536 transparent RGBA sprite sheet: TWO columns by THREE rows of equal 512 x 512 cells. Draw six SMALL fully isolated plants with very wide empty transparent gutters. Reference locks three open cream bell blossoms, one unopened bud, curved attached green stems and the same broad green leaf rosette and painted identity. Constant front camera, scale, base position and lighting. Six row-major poses: neutral hanging bells; stems bend a little right with bells lagging left; right nod apex showing a little bell interior; upright returning with bells trailing right; stems lean left, bells lag right; left nod apex. Draw genuinely different stem curves, petal/inner-bell visibility and overlapping leaf contours; flower tip excursion 20px. The rosette base stays still. Keep all three bells and one bud connected; no growing/extra/detached flowers, disappearing leaves or whole-object rotating, scaling, sliding or rubber-warping. Crisp painted outlines and readable petal forms, moderate detail, no blur or glowing edge. Actual alpha transparency, no backdrop, shadows, matte, labels, numbers, cell borders or checkerboard pixels. Never touch or cross a cell edge; the wide transparent spacing is essential.
